text: {"claims": [{"id": "c1", "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S3", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P5.S3 states exactly that all checkpoints from sqlite3_wal_checkpoint() and the automatic mechanism are PASSIVE."}, {"id": "c2", "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S4", "rel": "refutes"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P5.S4 says FULL/RESTART can only be initiated by sqlite3_wal_checkpoint_v2(), not that calling it always produces them; the claim is stronger and unsupported."}, {"id": "c3", "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S2", "rel": "refutes"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P5.S2 says PASSIVE might not run to completion if there are concurrent readers or writers, contradicting the guarantee."}, {"id": "c5", "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S1", "rel": "entails"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P7.S1 states a checkpoint can reset the WAL only if no other connections use it; the claim's 'always' is stronger than 'only able to'."}, {"id": "c8", "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S0", "rel": "refutes"}], "check": null, "reasoning": "P2.S0 says a long-running read transaction can prevent a checkpointer from making progress, contradicting 'never delay'."}]}
